_help: Every consumer app FGN has decided about. action = remove, keep or ask-client. method = how it is removed: appx (a Store app, use package), uninstall (an installed program, use program) or command (your own command, use program and command). package and program may use * as a wildcard; exclude lists names to leave out. The first matching entry wins. Apps that are NOT listed here are shown as NEW and cannot be removed until you add them. Keep the commas and quotes exactly as in the entries below. See _examples for the other methods.

_examples.name: Example: installed program, its own uninstaller
_examples.reason: silentArgs is only added when the uninstaller has no quiet mode of its own. Leave it out if not needed.

_examples.name: Example: your own command
_examples.reason: The command is run as written. The app counts as removed when its program entry is gone. winget is not there if the Store was removed.

_examples.name: Example: Store app
_examples.reason: The Store app is removed for every user and from the Windows image.
